title: Azurine walking, stride A (tinted)
prompt:

Her LEFT foot steps forward from under the hem, the gown swinging forward with it; one hand lifts her skirt a little, the other relaxed. Feet and hem on one level ground line at the very bottom of the canvas; the head at the same height as in the standing pose. Nothing changes between the two frames but the stride and the swing of the gown. Isolated on a transparent background (or flat pure magenta #FF00FF if transparency is unavailable).
Image 1 is the standing character and fixes the exact costume, colours, face, belt, tights, cape, armour and prop sides. Do not reinterpret the costume. Preserve anatomically coherent hands gripping any carried weapons; exactly two arms and two legs. Draw a clearly separated full walking stride with the two feet apart, never the standing pose. Both soles meet the same horizontal baseline at the bottom; keep the standing head and plume/circlet height. No ground or cast shadow. Canvas aspect ratio 200:380; one isolated transparent sprite, target delivery 200 x 380.
